name: Judith Baker
text: AyLin is truly extraordinary. Her experience and professionalism immediately made an impact on my progress. I have worked with many teachers across four languages and AyLin is among the best.

name: Jose Escarce
text: All the lessons with Aylin are excellent and this one was no exception. We do many different things during the lessons, including studying grammar topic, reading and conversation, which makes for a superb experience. She also gives me homework assignments, which every couple of weeks include writing a short essay. This is extremely helpful as well. I recommend Aylin highly.

name: Marcio Barbosa
text: Aylin is a great teacher! I've been studying Turkish language for over a year and had 5 teachers already. Aylin is by far the best! She explains well, gives good examples, encourages learning, makes learning fun and is flexible to suit my busy and ever changing schedule. She also has good materials and resources to ensure your learning. I am sure that Aylin will help you on your Turkish learning experience! She is a real teacher!

name: Thomas
text: AyLin is one of the most effective teachers I've worked with. She really understands language learning, both from a theoretical perspective and how to put a plan into practice. I highly recommend working with her over an extended period of time.
